plugins.name: flutter-skills
plugins.description: Comprehensive Flutter development skills for Claude Code — Riverpod 3.0, Freezed, go_router, Flame game engine, and feature-first architecture

skills.name: flutter-dev
skills.description: Flutter development best practices with Riverpod 3.0, Freezed, go_router, and feature-first architecture. Auto-invoked when writing Flutter/Dart code.
skills.description_zh: 提供采用 Riverpod 3.0、Freezed、go_router 和按功能组织架构的 Flutter/Dart 开发实践。

skills.name: flutter-feature
skills.description: Scaffold a complete new feature with models, providers, repositories, screens, widgets, and tests following feature-first architecture
skills.description_zh: 按功能优先架构为新 Flutter 功能生成模型、provider、仓库、页面、组件和测试完整骨架。

skills.name: flutter-game
skills.description: Create 2D/3D games with Flutter using Flame Engine, Rive animations, and modern game architecture. Use when building games, mini-games, or gamified features.
skills.description_zh: 使用 Flame Engine、Rive 动画和现代游戏架构开发 Flutter 二维或三维游戏、小游戏及游戏化功能。

skills.name: flutter-model
skills.description: Generate a Freezed data model with JSON serialization, optional state class, and factory. Use when creating new data models or DTOs.
skills.description_zh: 生成支持 JSON 序列化、可选状态类和工厂的 Freezed 数据模型，用于新模型或 DTO。

skills.name: flutter-provider
skills.description: Generate a Riverpod 3.0 provider with notifier, state management, and AwBaseNotifier lifecycle. Use when creating state management for features.
skills.description_zh: 生成包含 notifier、状态管理及 AwBaseNotifier 生命周期的 Riverpod 3.0 provider，用于功能状态管理。

skills.name: flutter-screen
skills.description: Generate a Flutter screen with go_router routing, Riverpod state management, and proper lifecycle. Use when creating new pages/screens.
skills.description_zh: 生成带 go_router 路由、Riverpod 状态管理及适当生命周期的 Flutter 页面。

skills.name: flutter-test
skills.description: Generate comprehensive tests for Flutter providers, repositories, and widgets with mockito mocks and Riverpod overrides
skills.description_zh: 为 Flutter provider、仓库和组件生成全面测试，使用 mockito 模拟与 Riverpod 覆盖。
